reason: Although framed as a move/refactor, this PR touches a broad cross-section of core planner and executor paths for physical window operators: plan construction, implementation rules, optimizer/task flow, resolve-indices, explain/stringer, plan-to-PB, and executor builder. Window planning is part of SQL semantics and runtime correctness, and cross-file relocation in these central paths is risky enough to justify a focused deep review for hidden high-severity regressions.
